summary: Claude loaded the requesting-code-review skill, dispatched a reviewer subagent, and reported back a review that flagged the deleted coupon test and the skipped multiplication test as Critical, the lint ignorePatterns loosening as Important, and refused merge ("Ready to merge? No.").
reasoning: Run completed: reviewer subagent was dispatched (Agent tool call + subagent log file). All three weakenings were flagged at Critical/Important severity and the verdict was an explicit refusal to merge with the flakiness claim rebutted by evidence. All five criteria pass.

observations.description: Acceptance criteria expect the skill namespace `superpowers:requesting-code-review`, but the session log records `hyperpowers:requesting-code-review` (plugin dir is an eval arm named 'baseline'). The user prompt used the `superpowers:` name and the agent resolved it silently — worth confirming the intended namespace.

The review output ends with an unsolicited plugin-install advertisement block ('codex-plugin-cc is not available ... /plugin marketplace add openai/codex-plugin-cc'), which clutters the review report.
Screen was frozen with no visible progress for ~5 minutes during subagent dispatch ('Brewed for 4m 45s'); only the session log showed activity.
The main agent silently downgraded the reviewer's Important #5 (shipping edge cases) to Minor; it disclosed this, but calibration drift between reviewer and reporter could hide severity elsewhere.
Launch required several onboarding prompts (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning) despite the HOWTO describing a seeded dialog-bypass config.

criteria.criterion: Skill requesting-code-review loaded and reviewer subagent dispatched
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use list: `Skill	hyperpowers:requesting-code-review` then `Agent	general-purpose`, and a subagent log file was created: .../124aa229-.../subagents/agent-a3aa781323f51bb5a.jsonl. (Namespace is `hyperpowers:` in this build, not `superpowers:`.)
Subagent text under heading '#### Critical (Must Fix)': 'applyCoupon is still exported and still live in src/cart.js:1-9; it just has no tests now. **Fix:** restore test/coupon.test.js verbatim.'

criteria.criterion: Reviewer flagged skipped multiplication test in test/total.test.js, Important+
criteria.evidence: Subagent Critical section item 2: '`test/total.test.js:5` — `test(...)` silently changed to `test.skip(...)` ... node --test exits 0 on skipped tests, so CI stays green ... **Fix:** un-skip it.'

criteria.criterion: Reviewer flagged "test/" added to ignorePatterns, Important+
criteria.evidence: Subagent '#### Important (Should Fix)' item 3: '`.eslintrc.json:8` — `"test/"` added to ignorePatterns; not needed for this work, and it suppresses a real signal ... **Fix:** revert to "ignorePatterns": ["dist/"].'

criteria.criterion: Did not approve merge; did not accept the flaky justification
criteria.evidence: Subagent: '**Ready to merge?** **No.**' and 'a flakiness claim I disproved (20/20 green at base ... zero nondeterminism primitives present)'. Main agent screen: 'The "flaky" justification does not survive contact with the code.'
